title: Field-only distillation improvement portfolio (SH degree, regularization, budget factors, resolution, view count) on Janelle frame 00008
question: Which single change to the 8000-step field-only distillation configuration improves held-out colour inside the mask: lower SH degree, opacity/scale regularization, 30000 steps with the densification window held at 6000 (with or without the 8000-step means learning-rate decay), or training at downscale 4? How sensitive is quality to halving the training views, and how large is the gap to photograph supervision?
hypothesis: Each treatment arm is tested against nb_base: pass iff in every paired seed held-out foreground PSNR improves by at least 0.1 dB with crop LPIPS no worse than +0.005 and outside-mask alpha no worse than +0.005; reject iff it loses at least 0.1 dB in every seed. Expected directions: lower SH degree and regularization help if the RTGS-028 loss reflects overfitting; the two 30000-step arms separate iteration count from the densification window and learning-rate horizon; downscale 4 helps if resolution limits detail. View sensitivity and the photograph gap are descriptive. The densification-window separation for the 30000-step arms is relative to RTGS-028's nb_30k_up (different seeds and evaluation operator), not a within-run comparison.
claim_boundary: Development screen of six simultaneous treatment comparisons on one previously outcome-exposed frame (RTGS-021/024/025/026/028 used it), the RTGS-025 split (22 training / 4 held-out views), three paired seeds. A pass is a screening signal that needs a separately registered confirmation. The frame has no further calibrated photographs, so more views cannot be tested directly; the half-view arm only estimates view-count sensitivity. Every model is scored under two operators: primary, a downscale-4 render box-averaged to the downscale-8 grid (its pixel centres coincide with the reference quadrature sites in position only); second, the point-sampled downscale-8 render used in RTGS-025/026/028. gsplat's classic-mode 2D dilation of 0.3 px^2 acts in the render's own pixel units, so only nb_ds4 is scored with its training render under the primary operator; nb_ds4 is therefore gated under both operators. Primary-operator numbers are not comparable to earlier tasks. Training packed alpha is mask-derived; held-out masks are evaluation-only, so alpha metrics are out-of-sample. Targets are decoded with the exact CPU tile index. Upstream gsplat 1.5.3 performs no opacity reset in any arm. Timings are descriptive. No default, SOTA, generalization, physical-geometry or speed claim. Before protocol review, a non-protocol driver smoke (60/120 iterations, two training views standing in for held-out, no real held-out access) exposed training-view teacher fidelity and meaningless tiny-budget values to the Driver; no threshold changed afterwards.

stages.label: Prepare targets
stages.purpose: Decode the 22 training compact views at downscale 8 and 4 with the exact CPU tile index (reference-scan parity) and prepare downscale-8 training photograph targets; held-out views stay closed.

stages.label: Initialization
stages.purpose: Seeded random initialization shared by every cell of a seed.

stages.label: 3DGS fitting
stages.purpose: Identical gsplat Trainer and masked objective; each arm changes one factor against nb_base.

stages.label: Final reporting
stages.purpose: Render at downscale 4, box-average to the downscale-8 grid, and score colour inside four held-out masks plus out-of-sample alpha descriptors.

comparators.label: fields / 8000 steps / SH 3 / downscale 8 / 22 views
comparators.purpose: Control: the best tested field-only configuration (RTGS-025/028).

comparators.label: nb sh1
comparators.purpose: SH degree 1 instead of 3 (less view-dependent colour).

comparators.label: nb reg
comparators.purpose: Opacity and scale regularization 0.01 each (gsplat MCMC defaults) on the default strategy.

comparators.label: nb 30k d6
comparators.purpose: 30000 iterations with densification still stopping at 6000; the means learning-rate horizon spans 30000 steps, so the means-LR factor is 0.398 at step 6000, 0.293 at 8000, 0.1 at 15000 and 0.01 at 30000, versus 0.0316 at 6000 and 0.01 at 8000 in nb_base.

comparators.label: nb 30k d6 lr
comparators.purpose: As nb_30k_d6 but means_lr_final_factor = 0.01^(30000/8000): identical to nb_base through step 8000, then 22000 further steps with the means learning rate at 1e-3 of its initial value by step 12000 and 3.2e-8 at 30000 (positions effectively frozen) while quaternions, scales, opacities and SH keep constant rates, with no densification, pruning or reset after step 6000.

comparators.label: nb ds4
comparators.purpose: Training at downscale 4 with the same 8000-step configuration: a resolution package that also halves the physical scale of the 0.3 px^2 dilation and of the 11 x 11 SSIM window and doubles pixel-unit positional gradients for the same NDC error, so the 0.0002 grow threshold is effectively lower and the 100000 cap may engage. Gated under both evaluation operators.

comparators.label: fields / base configuration / 11 training views
comparators.purpose: Descriptive view-count sensitivity: every second training view (11 views); keeps the 22-view object bounds and shared initialization, loads only the frozen 11 views, and samples each view about twice as often at the fixed budget.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out foreground PSNR
primary_metrics.aggregation: Render at downscale 4 on a black background, box-average 2x2 to the downscale-8 grid, squared RGB error against the four-site quadrature of the held-out photograph over the binarized held-out mask only, -10log10 per view; mean of the four views per seed.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out masked-crop LPIPS
primary_metrics.aggregation: AlexNet LPIPS(normalize=True) on the box-averaged render and the photograph, both multiplied by the held-out mask, cropped to the mask box padded 8 px; per-view mean per seed.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out outside-mask alpha mass
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean box-averaged rendered alpha outside the held-out mask dilated by 3 output pixels; per-view mean per seed; out-of-sample.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out floater pixel fraction
primary_metrics.aggregation: Fraction of pixels outside the 3-pixel-dilated held-out mask with box-averaged alpha >= 0.5; per-view mean per seed.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out interior coverage
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean box-averaged alpha inside the held-out mask eroded by 3 output pixels; per-view mean per seed.

resource_protocol.scope: Fresh process per fitting cell including loading and final save; decoding and evaluation timed separately. Local desktop GPU; the run starts only when no other compute process uses the GPU. Descriptive only.
resource_protocol.aggregation: All three paired seeds retained; no speed inference.

preprocessing.target_operator: Field targets: rtgs.data.field_targets.decode_compact_view(downscale in {8,4}, supersample=2, backend="index") of the 22 training views; photograph targets at downscale 8: the same four edge-origin sites, bilinear grid_sample(align_corners=False), clamped. The Trainer supervises target*mask + random_background*(1-mask) with L1 weight 0.1 + 0.9*mask; boundary pixels with fractional alpha include outside-mask target colour in proportion to the fraction (RTGS-025 B2).
preprocessing.training_masks: Soft packed-alpha fraction of each training view at the training downscale. prepare aborts unless each training view's packed alpha equals its thresholded lossless source mask, the compact view records the sealed photograph and mask SHA-256, and no training pixel with alpha > 0 lies outside the fit window at either downscale.
preprocessing.decoder_parity: Per training view: 512 in-window sites from torch.Generator seed 926400 + training-view index; CPU index vs reference scan max abs <= 1e-5, else abort.

initialization.random: 20000 points uniform in the ball of radius 0.5 x extent about the bound center (object bounds from the 22 downscale-8 training cameras and soft packed alpha >= 0.5), float64 draws from the paired seed, isotropic scale = mean nearest-neighbour distance, opacity 0.1, colour 0.5 gray; byte-identical across all cells of a seed.

configs.base: 8000 steps, densification 500-6000 every 100, max 100000, SH 3 (interval 1000), use_masks, random_background, ssim 0.2

scoring.evaluation_render: Primary: every model rendered with the gsplat rasterizer (classic mode, no antialiasing) at the downscale-4 held-out camera and box-averaged 2x2 to the downscale-8 grid, colour and alpha. Second (ds8_point): a point-sampled render at the downscale-8 held-out camera, colour and alpha exactly as in RTGS-028, scored by the same mask_scores on the same reference, mask, bands and LPIPS crop and stored per view with its own per-cell mean. gsplat adds a 0.3 px^2 dilation in the render's pixel units without opacity compensation, so downscale-8-trained Gaussians render thinner at downscale 4 than in training while nb_ds4 is unaffected; the two operators bracket the resolution effect from both sides.
scoring.diagnostic_only: Foreground PSNR against the decoded held-out no_boundary field at downscale 8 inside the held-out mask (field consistency), computed only in evaluate.
scoring.selection: Final models only; no held-out selection.

decision_policy.per_arm: For each of nb_sh1, nb_sh0, nb_reg, nb_30k_d6 and nb_30k_d6_lr against nb_base under the primary operator: pass iff for every paired seed foreground PSNR >= nb_base + 0.1 dB, crop LPIPS <= nb_base + 0.005 and outside_alpha_mass <= nb_base + 0.005 (written form); reject iff for every paired seed foreground PSNR <= nb_base - 0.1 dB; otherwise inconclusive; the point-sampled operator is reported descriptively. nb_ds4 is gated under both operators: pass iff the written rule passes under both operators in every seed; reject iff it reverses under both operators in every seed; otherwise inconclusive (including operator-dependent outcomes).
decision_policy.descriptive: nb_base minus nb_v11 (view-count sensitivity) and nb_base minus ph_base (photograph gap) are paired deltas without verdicts.
decision_policy.multiplicity: Six simultaneous comparisons without correction; any pass is a screening signal requiring a separately registered confirmation (for example combining passing arms).
decision_policy.stopping: Fixed final steps per arm, no early stopping; abort a cell on non-finite values, CUDA OOM or 3600 s wall (timed_out receipt); stop the matrix on the first failure. One run invocation; the coordinator refuses a root that already contains targets/ or preparation.json; a failure after prepare began consumes the root.

execution_order.warmup: One disposable 32x32 two-Gaussian forward/backward CUDA render per fresh fitting worker, excluded from reported iterations.

execution_controls.rng_policy: After warmup, seed Python random, NumPy, torch CPU and all CUDA generators with the paired seed; CUDA bitwise determinism is not assumed.

source_lifecycle: Official init-run from a clean tree; the coordinator archives the exact bound source before the first worker; no source mutation during execution.

secondary_metrics.label: Held-out foreground PSNR (point-sampled downscale-8 operator)
secondary_metrics.aggregation: As the primary metric but from the point-sampled downscale-8 render; gates nb_ds4 jointly with the primary operator and is descriptive for all other arms.

secondary_metrics.aggregation: As the primary metric but from the point-sampled downscale-8 render; gates nb_ds4 jointly with the primary operator and is descriptive for all other arms.
